sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • FOMC decision day, Warsh’s debut (14:00 decision / 14:30 press conference, both yet to occur): The market broadly expects rates to remain unchanged at 3.50%-3.75% (interest-rate futures imply roughly a 97% probability of no move). The focus is entirely on the wording in new Chair Kevin Warsh’s first press conference and the dot plot—May CPI rose to 4.2% YoY (a three-year high), and analysts expect the FOMC to remove the previously remaining expectation of a single rate cut, confirming “higher for longer.” As of 12:24 ET (about 174 minutes after the open), the whole market was in a typical “pinned before the FOMC decision” pattern: SPY 750.93 (+0.05%, grinding in a narrow 747.98–752.13 range all day), QQQ 733.69 (+0.52%, supported by semiconductors), DIA +0.40%, and IWM 295.23 (+1.05%) leading. The community jokingly called it “the gambler’s Super Bowl at 2.”
  • U.S.-Iran MOU may be signed remotely ahead of schedule today: According to Axios, the memorandum signing originally scheduled for Friday may be moved up to an electronic signing today, with the Strait of Hormuz clause taking effect immediately, pre-war shipping volume restored within 30 days, and the ceasefire extended by 60 days (including Lebanon). However, Trump’s repeated remarks at the G7 press conference that “if I’m not satisfied, I’ll drop bombs again” led the community to believe the “deal won’t actually get signed / will only be a conceptual signing.” Oil’s reaction was muted: USO 115.21 (-0.22%, after briefly surging to 119.87 intraday before falling back), XLE 54.94 (-0.76%).
  • Trump’s G7 press conference became an anxiety amplifier for the community: His long, rambling remarks (“Mohammad something 50/50,” granite being harder than marble, General Raisin Cane, etc.) had the community both mocking his condition and watching for him to “talk the market up” at any moment.
  • “Bag7” mega-cap tech stocks continued to collapse: META 581.21 (-3.16%), AMZN 240.63 (-2.24%), GOOGL 365.48 (-2.11%), and MSFT 385.71 (-2.10%) all fell, with only semiconductors strengthening against the trend.
  • SPCX, a newly listed stock, saw a violent shakeout: 196.78 (-2.53%), plunging from the open at 209.76 all the way to an intraday low of 187.06 before rebounding, as the bull-bear battle turned white-hot.
  • HOOD erupted: 108.37 (+12.06%), breaking above 108 intraday and becoming the community’s biggest winning topic.

社区气氛：总体而言，市场陷入了一种“在联邦公开市场委员会(FOMC)决定之前就陷入困境”的恼怒和分裂状态——指数横盘整理，大型科技股在流血，半导体加小型股则逆势狂欢。大多数人都持有现金，等待两点，情绪反复摇摆，一边是赌博般的希望“沃什会鸽派并提振市场”，一边担心鹰派取消宽松措辞会引发大屠杀。特朗普无休止的喋喋不休已经从信仰转变为疲惫不堪的嘲讽。

恐慌/贪婪：有点焦虑，但接近中性。 VIX 多次因异常的分钟级跳跃而被提及，社区对“表面之下的紧缩情况”保持警惕，但市场本身的波动极小——典型的决策前低成交量压缩。

情绪与现实：社区以 Bag7 出血和 SPCX 暴跌为主，总体感觉像是一场“大屠杀”，但实际上 SPY 只是小幅下跌，而 QQQ/IWM 变绿——这显然是一轮板块轮动（资本从软件/大盘科技转向半导体、小盘和金融科技），而不是系统性下跌。社区的悲观情绪比指数走势更加夸张。
